name: self-compact
description: Claude Code plugin that lets Claude compact its own context at task milestones: agent-initiated /compact with self-written handoff instructions, gated by context size, then auto-continue. Smarter auto-compact for long sessions. English and Chinese UI.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of everything the plugin shows or tells Claude: "en" (default) or "zh". Any other value falls back to English.

floorPct.title: Extra floor (%)
floorPct.description: Optional extra floor as a percentage of the window; the floor is the larger of this and the floorCalls size. 0 disables it

floorCalls.title: Floor payback (calls)
floorCalls.description: The floor is the context size at which compacting pays back within this many later calls. At least 2

nodeCalls.title: Node payback (calls)
nodeCalls.description: Any clean node may compact from the size that pays back within this many calls. At least 2

workCalls.title: Work payback (calls)
workCalls.description: The turn-end self-check treats a block of work as a node from the size that pays back within this many calls. At least 2

urgentK.title: Urgent size (k tokens)
urgentK.description: From this size (capped at 80% of the window) the reminder escalates to compacting at the next safe step; every other tier is capped at it. Minimum 50

compactCostK.title: Compaction cost (k tokens)
compactCostK.description: Fixed cost of one compaction (summary plus re-caching) in the payback formula. Minimum 1

nudgeStepPct.title: Nudge step (%)
nudgeStepPct.description: Remind again after each further rise of this many percentage points

hotWindow.title: Hot skill window (requests)
hotWindow.description: A skill used within this many main requests is hot at compaction: its references ride the resume message. Minimum 1

refInlineK.title: Inline reference size (k tokens)
refInlineK.description: A skill reference of at most this many thousand tokens is inlined into the resume message; larger ones are listed by path. 0 lists every reference

skillBudgetK.title: Skill reference budget (k tokens)
skillBudgetK.description: Total thousand tokens of inlined skill references per compaction. 0 inlines nothing

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When off, every compact_now call is denied and no nudges are sent

releaseStopHooks.title: Release Stop hooks
releaseStopHooks.description: Let a queued compaction end a turn that another Stop hook (such as /goal) holds open. Has no effect where Claude Code's built-in guard (cc-plugin-sec-default) loads — Team/Enterprise logins and machines with managed settings — because user mods' Stop hooks don't run there.

autoNodes.title: Autonomous node triggers
autoNodes.description: Flag node-like tool calls (push, PR, spec/plan written, todos done), run a turn-end self-check and hint on topic switches so Claude compacts without being asked. Off disables all three

turnEndCheck.title: Turn-end self-check
turnEndCheck.description: After a node or a long uncompacted stretch, submit one short prompt asking Claude whether to compact. Needs Autonomous node triggers

exitCompact.title: Compact on /exit
exitCompact.description: When you leave with /exit and the context is past the break-even line, Claude writes a handoff and compacts first, then the session exits, so a later resume starts small. Closing the window or Ctrl+C exits as usual
